description: A richly warm, Parisian-influenced living room corner photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a three-quarter corner view that shows both the applied moulding wall at center and the floor-length drapery at the right edge. The wall features full-height applied panel moulding in a classic French style, painted in a warm greige or camel tone — a slightly dusty, aged sand color — that creates a sophisticated backdrop. Floor-length drapery in a matching muted camel or taupe velvet or heavyweight linen fabric hangs from ceiling height to floor along the right wall, its pleated folds catching diffuse light from a window edge at far right that creates a soft bright fill from outside. In the lower foreground, a low-slung leather sofa or loveseat in rich cognac-brown occupies the left and center bottom of the frame, dressed with a pair of leather throw cushions in the same deep brown and a contrasting dusty sage linen pillow. A warm amber glow radiates from a wall-mounted position at center, illuminating the moulding panels with a warm circular pool and casting a small downward spill on the wall below. The palette is uniformly warm and luxurious — cognac leather, camel plaster, antique gold, and pale sage — with a deeply romantic and formal atmosphere.
